messages.subject: dsm data import problem
parts:
Hi List=20

=20

I am trying to set up a DSM project but can't figure out how to get my
data in - please help me!=20

=20

My data are bird observations collected on boat surveys using line
transect methods. I've cjopped the transects up into segments and
created 3 text files for transect, segment and observation data (as
described in the help files) but I don't understand how to get the
segment layer in. If I create a data layer under transect I can import
the segment data, but then when I come to import the observation data
there is no option (that I can see) to import this under the segment
layer, and so the two can't be linked.

=20

Should the observation layer be nested in the segment layer, or are they
effectively parallel? If the latter, does that mean the observation data
needs to include a transect identifier, as well as a segment identifier
(if so this is contrary to my reading of the help description)?

=20

I'd be happy doing this in R directly, if someone can point me in the
direction of slightly more comprehensive instructions than are included
in the dsm package.=20

=20

Many thanks

Mark
